title: Stall-Safe Completed Publication Recovery
owner_directive: If a conversation stalls during main publication, finished operations must be recoverably handed off and the FIFO lease must be released so non-stalled conversations can continue.
reproduced_failure: UISR-11 publication completed durably while the originating conversation stalled during main-use closeout.
The active publication lease remained capable of blocking unrelated queued conversations until another executor intervened.
implementation: OPERATING_CONTRACT 3.4.0 defines cross-conversation recovery release for turns whose merge is already durably verified.
BOOTSTRAP requires recovery handoff plus release instead of waiting for the stalled conversation.
ops3_merge_lease.py adds recover_completed_turn with generation, holder, fresh-main, verified-merge and recovery-location checks.
Control-plane regression tests prove queue preservation, next-holder progress, fail-closed main mismatch and mandatory recovery location.
